extracted.name: All-Fruit Smoothies
extracted.description: There's nothing in this smoothie except pineapple juice, banana, and frozen strawberries and blueberries. It's smooth, frosty, and dairy-free.
instruction_lines: Pour pineapple juice into a blender and add banana, strawberries, and blueberries. Cover and blend until smooth, about 1 minute. Pour into 2 glasses.
